text:
Between 14:02 UTC and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502 errors. A software deployment removed the cache warmup step at 14:02 UTC. The missing cache warmup step caused server errors on API routes.

Engineers identified the problem and reverted the deployment at 14:27 UTC. The system created new cache entries and restored normal operation at 14:31 UTC. All API endpoints now process requests normally without errors.

We updated our deployment pipeline to prevent similar incidents. The deployment pipeline now requires the cache warmup step before a deployment can start.
